6.350 rsStateIndicatorInvalidTransformationScope
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsStateIndicatorInvalidTransformationScope is a critical error that will occur when a StateIndicator
element has StateIndicator.TransformationType set to "Percentage" and either
StateIndicator.MinimumValue.Value or StateIndicator.MaximumValue.Value is set to "NaN",
but the StateIndicator does not have StateIndicator.TransformationScope specified.
